originality.rationale: Inspected full primary papers establish diagonal central section volumes and stability, not extremal affine ellipsoids of either halfcube. A published related orthotope result optimizes two-piece Euclidean inradius, logically weaker than the new exact Löwner shape and complete contacts. General MVEE algorithms give existence and computation but do not supply the evaluated parity formulas. value.rationale: A natural central diagonal cut in cube-section theory creates non-centrally symmetric halfbodies. Exact John and Löwner ellipsoid classifications yield a nontrivial parity-sensitive covariance design and the exceptional all-contact d=3, edge-contact d=5, edge-nontangent odd d>=7 transition. The all-dimensional contact-count formulas go beyond mere radii, generic algorithms, or routine tabulation.
